## 9ee024f29fdb

**Reproduced exact-control failure.** Generator SHA-256 `e8ccd805a267a486c6305ee72c4121392baaf8b1fc085eda964a76e2a5c52512`, canonical rule hash `82f439b3efb8`.

A documented-domain call with difficulty `hard`, seed `99117`, sample index `0`, and overrides `grid_h=17`, `grid_w=17`, `eight_density=0.55`, `eight_layout="column"`, `decoy_palette_size=0` passes `self_check`. The 17×17 grid has 144 non-lattice interior cells, so the density request implies about 79 color-8 cells. `_eight_layout` instead returns the at-most-12 cells in one column, realizing `12/144 = 0.083333...`. The accepted exact control is therefore silently capped by layout capacity, and no `observe_overrides` hook reports the realized value.

The input, canonical Racket output, source/rule hashes, observed counts, and supported apply command are in `checks/audit/9ee024f29fdb/counterexample.json`; Racket receipt: `checks/audit/9ee024f29fdb/racket.json`.

The read-only audit battery independently found missing `RULE_HASH`, unprobeable grid-axis metadata, accepted unknown overrides, missing exact-axis provenance, degenerate textures in the ordinary domain, weak self-check impostor acceptance, low canonical-envelope support (9/60; exact 7/60), no semantic contract, and active authority text divergence. It finished with 6 failed stages; see `checks/audit/9ee024f29fdb/battery/checks/9ee024f29fdb_after_battery_summary.json`. No audit target files were modified.
